project.name: Neighbor Voice and Meeting Windows
project.purpose: Standalone Windows dictation with a local copy of cat animation; meeting features follow Mac validation.

commands.notes: Windows native build/test commands are owned by windows.yml; this macOS shell has no dotnet on PATH. No local Windows result is claimed.

patterns: Core uses interfaces for audio, transcription, text delivery and credentials; Windows supplies platform adapters.
Native entry point and core tests run from scripts/build.ps1.
tests: Neighbor.Tests is the net48 offline/platform/UI test executable.
NekoChat.Animation.Tests validates bundled frames against Assets/manifest.json.
